summary: Prostate adenocarcinoma rules organized around benign glands, Gleason patterns 3/4/5, cribriform architecture, lumina, and stromal interfaces.

rules.claim: Do not partially transect a coherent benign gland during a generic tumor or stroma burden edit.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A dedicated benign-to-Gleason-3 transformation primitive with explicit architectural review.
counterexamples: Replacing one side of a round benign gland while preserving the opposite rim.
Using a luminal gap as stroma and growing tumor through it.
expected_morphology: Benign gland circumference and lumen remain recognizable and connected.
forbidden_morphology: Half-gland deletion, abrupt epithelial notch, lumen filling, or detached residual epithelium.
known_limitations: Basal-cell confirmation is not available on H&E alone in difficult foci.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: A pattern-3 burden edit must preserve discrete, individual, well-formed gland architecture and must not create fusion or solid growth.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: Tangential sectioning may make a locally incomplete contour; require neighboring context rather than guessing.
counterexamples: Bridging adjacent pattern-3 glands into a fused mass.
Expanding a pattern-3 label as a solid disk without gland lumina.
expected_morphology: Separate well-formed malignant glands with locally plausible lumina and spacing.
forbidden_morphology: Gland fusion, cribriform growth, solid sheets, single-cell spread, or filled lumina under a pattern-3 label.
known_limitations: The semantic mask does not explicitly encode gland instances or lumina; H&E critic review is mandatory.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Use pattern-4 labels only where H&E supports fused, poorly formed, cribriform, or glomeruloid malignant architecture; preserve internal cribriform spaces and overall unit coherence.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A small ambiguous focus requires abstention or expert review rather than forced classification.
counterexamples: Extending pattern 4 over separate well-formed glands.
Closing all cribriform holes with tumor.
Cutting a narrow notch through one side of a cohesive cribriform unit.
expected_morphology: The extension resembles the selected pattern-4 subtype and retains characteristic spaces where present.
forbidden_morphology: Pattern-3-like isolated glands, pattern-5-like solidification, arbitrary hole filling, or cribriform bisection.
known_limitations: Distinguishing poorly formed glands from tangential pattern 3 needs adequate local context.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Pattern-5 edits should match non-gland-forming solid sheets, cords, nests, single cells, or comedonecrotic architecture and must not invent well-formed glands.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A mixed-pattern field must preserve each fine label and use only same-pattern references.
counterexamples: Creating round luminal glands inside a pattern-5 sheet.
Extending pattern 5 into a field of discrete well-formed glands.
expected_morphology: Non-gland-forming extension continuous with a compatible pattern-5 component.
forbidden_morphology: Invented gland lumina, pattern-3 spacing, or silent overwrite of a lower-grade component.
known_limitations: Comedonecrosis must be distinguished from unrelated necrosis and artifacts.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound label_transition execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.

rules.claim: Do not treat gland lumina or intraluminal contents as stromal source regions or as holes that should be filled by morphology.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A profile may rasterize lumen inside an epithelial component; preserve it unless a dedicated luminal primitive exists.
counterexamples: Closing a cribriform or glandular lumen because it is a binary hole.
Shrinking tumor into its own lumen and calling the result stroma.
expected_morphology: Gland lumina remain topologically and visually coherent.
forbidden_morphology: Lumen filling, lumen-to-stroma substitution, or interface selection on the wrong side of epithelium.
known_limitations: The PANDA fine mask does not separately label lumina.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Spread the requested area along a broad existing interface of one compatible Gleason component before increasing penetration depth.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: If no broad compatible interface exists, abstain rather than force the area budget.
counterexamples: Meeting an area target by a deep wedge through one pattern-4 component.
Spreading across adjacent pattern 3 and pattern 5 components as if they were one interface.
forbidden_morphology: Deep slots, acute notches, cross-pattern bridges, or component merges.
known_limitations: Numeric depth/span thresholds require provider- and scale-specific calibration.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.
